title: Bulk mode on the Inactive tab behaves exactly as on the Active tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser with 2 tabs · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [User-A], signed in with the Admin role. Admin holds the 'Part Library & Inventory' permissions View, Create & Edit and Delete by default (Settings → Roles & Permissions); Delete is what allows Deactivate parts and Activate parts.
  • Location: [Loc-1], any one location [User-A] can pick in the location selector in the top bar.
  • Browser: a desktop browser window at least 1280 pixels wide (parts management is desktop and tablet only).
  • Data: at [Loc-1], 3 inactive parts: [Part-A] ("ZZAUTOTEST PL mirror Alpha", category [Cat-1]), [Part-B] ("ZZAUTOTEST PL mirror Bravo", [Cat-1]) and [Part-C] ("ZZAUTOTEST PL mirror Charlie", [Cat-2]); part numbers ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MIRROR-01 to -03 (examples).

Setup

  1. Sign in as [User-A] and pick [Loc-1] in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. [Cat-1] and [Cat-2] = two different categories from the Category list.
  3. Create [Part-A]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL mirror Alpha" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MIRROR-01 (examples), pick [Cat-1], type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-A] = the part number you typed.
  4. Create [Part-B]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL mirror Bravo" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MIRROR-02 (examples), pick [Cat-1], type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-B] = the part number you typed.
  5. Create [Part-C]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL mirror Charlie" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MIRROR-03 (examples), pick [Cat-2], type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-C] = the part number you typed.
  6. Make [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab type [Part-A] in the Search box, click its row, pick Part Status → Inactive in Edit Inventory Part, click Save, then click Deactivate in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation (leave Note (Optional) empty).
  7. Make [Part-B] inactive: on the Active tab type [Part-B] in the Search box, click its row, pick Part Status → Inactive in Edit Inventory Part, click Save, then click Deactivate in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation (leave Note (Optional) empty).
  8. Make [Part-C] inactive: on the Active tab type [Part-C] in the Search box, click its row, pick Part Status → Inactive in Edit Inventory Part, click Save, then click Deactivate in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation (leave Note (Optional) empty).
  9. Check the setup worked: the Inactive tab searched for ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MIRROR lists 3 rows.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Click the Inactive tab.
  3. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MIRROR in the Search box.
  4. Click the [Part-A] row.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar.
  7. Click Activate parts.
  8. Click the [Part-A] row.
  9. Click the [Part-A] row again.
  10. Click the checkbox in the header row.
  11. Click the checkbox in the header row again.
  12. Click the [Part-A] row.
  13. Click the [Part-B] row.
  14. Click the Description column header.
  15. Change the Search text to ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MIRROR-0 (all three parts still match).
  16. Click the [Part-A] row.
  17. Open the Category filter and pick [Cat-1].
  18. Open the Category filter and pick All categories.
  19. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  20. Press Escape to close the menu.
  21. Hover over the X at the right end of the bar.
  22. Click the X.
  23. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  24. Click Activate parts.
  25. Click the [Part-A] row.
  26. Click the [Part-B] row.
  27. Open a second browser tab on the same ShopView address and go to Parts → Inventory (tab 2).
  28. In tab 2, click the Inactive tab.
  29. In tab 2, type [Part-B] in the Search box.
  30. In tab 2, click the [Part-B] row.
  31. In tab 2, pick Part Status → Active.
  32. In tab 2, click Save.
  33. In tab 2, click Activate in the "Activate part?" confirmation.
  34. Go back to tab 1 without reloading it.
  35. In tab 1, click the Activate button on the bar.
  36. In tab 1, click Activate in the "Activate parts?" confirmation.
  37. Click Close on the toast.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: With bulk mode off, the row click opens Edit Inventory Part for [Part-A]; there is no checkbox column.
  • Step 7: The checkbox column and the dark bar appear, reading "0 selected", with a blue "Activate" button.
  • Step 8: The [Part-A] row is ticked ("1 selected") and no dialog opens.
  • Step 9: The [Part-A] row is unticked ("0 selected").
  • Step 10: All 3 loaded rows are ticked ("3 selected").
  • Step 11: All ticks are cleared ("0 selected").
  • Step 13: The bar reads "2 selected".
  • Step 14: The rows are re-ordered by Description and [Part-A] and [Part-B] stay ticked ("2 selected").
  • Step 15: The ticks are cleared ("0 selected") although all three parts are still listed.
  • Step 17: The ticks are cleared ("0 selected") and only [Part-A] and [Part-B] are listed.
  • Step 19: The menu offers only "Export".
  • Step 21: Hovering the X shows "Clear selection".
  • Step 22: Bulk mode ends; the checkbox column and the bar disappear.
  • Step 23: The menu lists "Cycle count", "Activate parts" and "Export" again.
  • Step 36: A red error toast reads "1 part updated, 1 could not be changed." and lists [Part-B] with the reason "Part is already in that state." Bulk mode stays on and only [Part-B] stays ticked ("1 selected"); [Part-A] leaves the Inactive list.
  • Step 37: The toast stays on screen until you close it, then closes.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S3-R3, S2-R5, S2-R10a, S2-R10b, S2-R9, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.6 (Inactive tab, Activate parts), board 4.8 (Branch: the menu while the mode is on). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R3: “S2-R3 to S2-R10b, S2-R14 to S2-R17 and S2-N3 apply on the Inactive tab exactly as on the Active tab, with "deactivate" read as "activate". The disabled button's hover text is "Tick the parts to activate".”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Bulk change, some parts failed): “"{n} parts updated, {m} could not be changed." ("1 part updated, {m} could not be changed." for one)”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Bulk change, some parts failed): “Error toast, stays until closed, lists each failed part and its reason”
  • S2-R5: “While the mode is on, a click anywhere on a row ticks or unticks that row instead of opening the part.”
  • S2-R10a: “Changing the search term or a filter clears the ticks, so the user only ever changes parts they can see. Sorting keeps them.”
  • S2-R10b: “While the mode is on, the actions menu offers only Export. Cycle count and the bulk entry come back when the mode ends.”
  • S2-R9: “An X button sits at the right end of the bar. Hovering it shows "Clear selection", which is also its screen reader label.”
